report:
Source reassessment: the complete claim requires stable source input, generating operation and occurrence to determine generated-source identity, with generated text and current origin coordinates excluded from identity; moving the origin must neither merge occurrences nor create replacement identity. The sole ordinary implementation association, derive.rs, interns source_item, derive_name, macro_def, attribute_index and derive_index in DeriveExpansion. Neither text nor coordinates is an interned field: origin queries the current source-item absolute span; text is obtained from the tracked builtin_derive_output query. parse_output uses ParseSource::Derive(self), preserving that expansion identity for generated parsing.

Both ordinary associated tests provide visible behavioral assertions. duplicate_derive_occurrences_have_distinct_generated_source_identity constructs two Clone occurrences, requires two derived impl expansions, asserts unequal expansion identities and indices 0/1; it detects accidental collapse by operation/name alone. moving_source_item_preserves_derive_expansion_identity edits the same SourceFile by adding a leading newline, compares expansion IDs across revisions, and requires changed origin start; it detects coordinate-based replacement identity or a frozen origin. Captured setup helpers establish actual source parsing and root-module construction; the captured BuiltinDeriveTcx supplies Clone macro metadata. These are integration examples, not exhaustive nested-generation coverage.

The third association, sage_meta::todo::types_spans_generated_identity, explicitly defers nested expansion identity/text/origin/coordinate comparisons. Its empty body is not behavioral evidence. The remaining prerequisite is a nested-expansion fixture and revision comparison matrix that observes generated text, source identity and origin coordinates together, including movement with repeated occurrences. This retains the historical declared verification gap and does not claim that all generated-source scenarios are implemented or verified. No N/A entries exist.

Baseline verification: I independently compared historical whole-source snapshots with current derive.rs, representation_spec.rs and sage-test-harness/lib.rs and found exact byte matches. The claim, implementation metadata and test metadata also match (historical embedded test source is now represented by fragments). I reassessed the historical rationale against every current associated test and the entire associated implementation, and captured relied-on fixture context using review read. No additional edits are required for this accepted, visibly deferred coverage.

Execution: I ran review start, review read and exact-comparison scripts, and am recording this report via review record. I did not execute behavioral tests or a build. The coordinator-reported 321 passing sage-meta tests and successful root build are separate reported execution, not independent behavioral evidence from this review.
